name: smith-machine-leg-press
instructions:
1. Set the bar at roughly 3 feet off the ground and assume a supine position with your feet on the bar hip width apart.
2. Extend your legs to lockout to unrack the safeties and then allow the bar to descend by bending your knees and flexing your hips.
3. Drive your feet into the bar and exhale as you extend your knees and hips.
4. Slowly lower back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
